name: Deadlock Sync
detail.live: Live memory reading is enabled. History recovery waits while you play.
detail.backfill: Recovering your own history automatically. Opening Deadlock pauses recovery and gives live sync priority.
detail.paused: Automatic recovery is off. Sync starts again next time you open Deadlock or launch Deadlock Match Backfill.
detail.idle: Starts with Deadlock or when you launch Deadlock Match Backfill.
detail.caught_up: No recovery is due. We will check again after your next game session.
detail.game: Live sync takes priority. History recovery resumes after Deadlock closes, once any cooldown ends.
detail.recovery.rate_limit: Steam rate-limited recovery. Our 24-hour cooldown includes a short random delay; Steam did not provide a reset time.
detail.recovery.transient: A temporary error interrupted recovery. The next attempt is scheduled automatically.
detail.recovery.account_in_use: Steam reports this account is playing a game. Recovery will retry when the account is available.
detail.recovery.auth: Sign in to Steam with Remember me, then choose Try again.
detail.recovery.unavailable: Some history is unavailable. Automatic recovery has stopped for those matches.
detail.recovery.state_store: Recovery tracking could not be read or saved. Check local storage access, then choose Try again.
detail.recovery.settling: Waiting briefly after the game closes before checking history.
Automatic recovery is enabled. Live sync always takes priority when Deadlock is open.

recovery.skipped.one: %1 older match reached the recovery attempt limit.
recovery.skipped.other: %1 older matches reached the recovery attempt limit.

detail.recovery.corrupt: Saved recovery tracking needs repair before automatic retries can resume. Live syncing can still run.
detail.live_failed: Live syncing stopped unexpectedly. Choose Try again to restart it; your game keeps running.
